name: ZombieSurvivor2
summary:
Zombie Survivor2 is a roguelite zombie survival game. Players need to avoid the pursuit of zombies, rescue other survivors and form a survival team.
Game Features: 
Support Mixed Reality desktop game mode, immersive control of survivors to escape, while avoiding 3D vertigo.
Gameplay:
After killing zombies, players can get crystals for upgrades, and can choose any reward for each upgrade. After the level is completed, game coins will be awarded for players to strengthen their combat capabilities.
